headline: Solar PPA Prices Jump 5% in Q3 Due to Trade Tariffs
summary: Solar power purchase agreement prices jumped 5% in the third quarter, mainly driven by new trade tariffs according to LevelTen.
why: Changes in solar PPA pricing directly impact the capital expenditures and project economics for clean energy developers and corporate renewable energy buyers.

impacts.name: Renewable Energy
impacts.why: Import tariffs increase procurement costs for solar panels, lifting power purchase agreement prices.
